title: Goa Mediclaim Scheme / Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government-supported health protection for eligible Goa residents, including hospitalization-related assistance under the applicable state programme.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on Goa residency and the current notified household/category criteria of the state health scheme.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Goa Mediclaim Scheme / Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
